messages.text: Your mom said check the blue app before work. The hall list changed again.
I saw it. I will print the new names and bring the tape.
Also call Ba Noi tonight if you can. Morning there already when you get home.
I will after shift. Tell Mom I can still help set chairs Friday.
Office left paper by door. They want all four signatures before Friday.
I can read it after shift. Is it just the March parking and key form?
Yes. Your mom put yours on table. Your brother needs to sign after school.
Tell him not to lose the blue pen again. I'll check the portal tonight.
You going straight home after shift?
No, meeting Linh and the cousins at the park courts for an hour. I packed shoes in the car.
Good. Move around, clear your head, then eat.
That is the plan. No badge talk after I change clothes.
Con, the clinic sent another blue button thing. I don't want to press wrong.
Leave it open. I'll check it after I sleep and put the appointment on your phone.
Ba said the paper says due 3/10? I only understand the number.
Send me a photo of the top half. If it is the bill, I can do it from my laptop tonight.
Con pick up fish sauce on way home if not too tired. I cooked thit kho already.
I can stop after shift. Do we still need rice too?
Rice okay. Dad come late from route, his back hurt. I packed extra for your brother.
Got it. I'll grab the bottle from Fubonn and be home before 8.
Mom says stop at Fubonn before you come home. Ginger, lemons, and the little red incense box.
Can you print my school form when you get home? Printer is doing the gray lines again.
Got it. Is this for Dad's back or for Saturday?
Yeah. I have to print my HR packet too before work, the one with the March plan choices and the new step table.
Both I think. She also said do not skip the clinic printout on the fridge.
Use Dad's laptop. Yours freezes when PDFs are big.
Good call. Need the pages with clinic cards, leave banks, and the paystub line before Friday.
I'll grab everything after my shift and check the appointment time when I get in.
Still down for Vertical World at 7:30? I booked the last lane near the overhang.
Yeah, leaving soon. I need to move around before my head stays stuck on work.
We can do the taco cart on Belmont after if it is still open.
Perfect. Two routes and something hot after, that is the plan.
If you go with Linh after basketball, keep your head clear. Early shift tomorrow.
I know. Just food after, maybe one glass if everyone orders. I am driving myself.
Good. Also do not stand outside with the coworkers during their break. Your jacket still smelled bad last week.
I stayed by the door for two minutes and regretted it. Tonight I am keeping my hoodie in the car.
For my civics slide, is it okay if I say the clip system can flag stuff but a person still has to check it?
Yeah. Say the flag is a clue, not proof. I would add blur faces, keep a log of who opens clips, and make supervisors explain why a tag stays.
So not just computers deciding who messed up.
Exactly. Also include trained interpreters and someone on call for people who are spiraling, not only more gear.
You go in again tonight?
Yeah, 22:00 to 06:00. That makes five this week unless they ask me to stay.
Eat first. Keep your head clear.
I packed rice already. Shirt is hanging so it doesn't wrinkle before I leave.
Con ve nha chua? I put rice and ca kho in fridge. You sounded tired after your long day.
Home now. Had to rewrite my log from the afternoon count because my trainer wanted the wording cleaner.
Eat first. Paper can wait a little. Did you ask about the medical card like we talked?
Yes, HR said the coverage starts after the next pay cycle and the retirement stuff is in the same packet.
Climb tonight or are you still doing family money math?
Can do 7:30. I already moved the 450 and paid my phone, just waiting on the grocery list.
Cheap post-climb then. No fancy bowls.
Perfect. I still have gas and car insurance coming out this week.
I put egg and rice in the small container. You have your blue folder?
I put your small hospital paper in the blue folder, same one with 2005 on the corner.
Yes. Going straight after sleep. The reading packet and old transcript copy are in there.
Thank you. I need the one that matches the DMV form, not the vaccine sheet.
Good. Finish one step at a time. You do not need to answer everyone, just show them with your work.
Check the line with September. I remember because we always do your family dinner around that week.
That is the plan. If I pass this round, I can bring the PCC forms home for you to look at.
Found it. I will scan it before work so I do not lose the original.
When you leave work, come straight home. There is rice and pork in the small pot.
Ok. I was about to stop on Powell but I will look in the pot first.
Also we need mint and lettuce tomorrow. The rolls will be better if you buy fresh.
I can do Fubonn after I sleep. If the pork is enough I will just get herbs and wrappers.
Can you look at my school board survey before I submit it? It asks what the neighborhood should fund first.
Put tutoring hours, lunch line staffing, and the nurse office being open more than two days. Also mention the crosswalk by 82nd after practice.
They also ask if anyone at home has county case numbers for the youth volunteer thing.
For us it should stay blank. I'll check the form when I get home so you don't guess.
You still coming to hoops at 8 or did work drain you?
Coming. I checked that incident write-up three times and still keep replaying the hallway part, so I need to run.
Then run with us, eat pho after, and leave the report at work.
Deal. Clinic person said movement and sleep log first, no daily pill thing for now.
Did you see that long thread about the DA race? People are already yelling under it.
I read the article and the county booklet part. Closing the app before I get dragged into replies.
Vertical World at 6? Also that Wonder Ballroom link dropped again.
Climb yes. I already set aside the punch card money, so the ticket tab is staying closed for now.
Fair. The comments are a mess. What are you weighing on it?
Fair. We can do cheap noodles after and you can still disappear into the wall for an hour.
Diversion numbers, jail staffing, and who explains the budget clearly. The little endorsement grid was less useful than the Q&A.
Perfect. My jaw has been doing that clicky thing too, so I might skip anything extra after.
I sent you that Smith Rock route post plus the Lisbon bakery save. Did either load?
Yeah, caught both on break. Also grabbed a 12-min hip warmup clip before I locked the app.
Good. You disappearing into clips before climbing would be very on brand.
Timer is on. After shower it's just a few pages of the courthouse book and sleep.
You came home quiet. Did the meeting with the sergeant go okay?
Okay enough. I answered too fast once, then slowed down and used the log examples instead of explaining my whole life.
Good. Clear head, clear words. People remember how you handle the hard minute.
I wrote that down. Also asked if I can help the two new officers with report format after count tomorrow.
You home already? Rice and fish in fridge.
Home. Going to rinse off, roll out the mat, then eat a little.
Put uniform in basket, not on chair. Tomorrow morning I need table clear for bills.
I know. I put the pile away before bed or I wake up wrong. Food later, thank you.
Are you still going to the gym wall before auntie's thing?
Yeah, 11:30. If you come with me, remind me to stop at Fred Meyer for the orange caplets and tape.
Again? You just played with Linh Wednesday.
I know. This one is just routes and stretching after, keeping it light.
I dropped those pasteis and seafood counter reels into the shared map. The Alfama one looks tiny, so maybe not for our first night.
Good call. I put stars by Baixa and Cais do Sodre too, plus the cheaper transit card note.
Also saw your Seoul ramen saves in the same folder lol, keeping that for the next round?
Yeah, different tab. I am trying to keep this one clean so Linh does not yell at me.
Con got paper from clinic today. Is it same thing you got last time?
Take a photo of the front and back for me. I want to match it with the clinic portal, not the Facebook picture auntie sent.
Ok. County letter also on table. You read after dinner?
Yeah, leave it by my keys. I will compare those two before I help him pick a day.
Con ve nha sau tra chua? Rice and ca kho still warm.
Yeah, coming straight home. Just me, no extra bowl needed.
Good. Your brother ate already. Lock side door when you come in.
Got it. I told the person from tonight I have work early, so home soon.
Can you grab rice and eggs after work? Mom said the big bag is almost done.
Yeah. I already used my card for Costco yesterday, 218. I'll do WinCo for eggs, greens, and fruit so we don't blow past the food line again.
Do we still have that school form asking for proof of home stuff?
I uploaded the lease page and pay stubs. There aren't extra letters to attach, so don't leave it for Mom.
Basketball at 7 still? Pho after if your legs survive.
Pho after basketball Thursday? I can cover if your county money is still hiding.
I'm good, the 6th posted. I'm stretching it until the next one hits.
Playing, yes. Skipping pho though. Tire place charged me $397 this morning.
Oof. You okay for the rest of the week?
Still no random weekend market table or app driving for you?
Nope. Just shifts and boring envelopes in my notes app.
Yeah, I moved money over and changed the food/gas rows on my phone. Home leftovers after we play.
I moved Thursday to 8 because your work block looked ugly.
Good call. I can get there by 8:10 if traffic from the facility is normal.
Mars box is already in my trunk. Malia said she can do setup if you are late.
Perfect. Put me last for first turn if I walk in late.
Home now. I parked and I'm going to shower before sleeping.
Good. Food is in the small pot. Don't buy outside.
Thank you. I have the 14:00 to 22:00 tomorrow, so I washed the shirt now.
Put it on the chair so it stays clean.
Auntie tagged you again lol. She wants the flyer pinned higher so the 82nd people see it.
I fixed it. Also can you tell your mom we need one more rice cooker Saturday?
Done. And don't forget the greeting line. Last time Uncle noticed you went straight to the food table.
I know, I know. I will say hi first, then disappear with plates.
Before work, keep your head clear. Did the clinic give you anything to take every morning?
No. Just the paper to track sleep, money thoughts, and when I reread messages too many times.
Good. Eat first. Your body is fine when you do not skip meals.
I packed rice and eggs. Bills tab is still open though, so I might make you check my math later.
Back is stiff again. I will use the warm coin rub after breakfast.
Okay, but keep the 10:40 appointment too. I put the address in your phone.
I know. Your mother also asked you to move the oranges near the photo shelf tonight.
I'll do it before I leave. I only know where things go if she points.
Did you ask payroll about the paper you showed me?
Not yet. They said the 457 line starts after the second full check, and the rate bump follows the signed MOU date.
Keep copies. Small lines on checks matter.
I saved screenshots. Also checked the hours bank before using one day for your appointment ride.
Con ve nha chua? Soup is on stove. I saved bowls for you and your brother.
Almost home. Did Dad see the maintenance note about the bathroom fan?
He called office. They come Monday 9-11. I wrote only us four can let them in.
Good. I'll be asleep then, so Mom or Dad can answer.
Can you grab cereal too? Mom said you are already going to Grocery Outlet.
Only if it is under $3. I am mainly getting eggs, greens, and whatever noodles are cheaper there.
There is still soup broth in the fridge btw. Don’t come home with fries again lol.
I know. If the broth is still good I will just warm that with noodles after shift.
Can you look at my history outline later or are you doing your packet again?
Both. I am on fractions until 8, then I can check yours before my shift.
You really made a whole schedule on the fridge lol
Because I know what happens when you let weeks slide. Bring me your outline before I leave.
Can you grab milk after work or are you stuck late again?
Stuck maybe 30. Someone refused the move to B side and I had to stand by while Vega talked him down.
So no milk?
I can still get it. I also need him to initial my debrief page before I leave.
Send me the garlic noodle clip before you forget. I want to try it after pickup tomorrow.
Sent. I only let myself save three things tonight: noodles, core circuit, and that dumb cat fall.
Three is disciplined for you. Are you still up?
A little. Phone is going face down and I'm doing two chapters with the missing-witness one.
You disappeared after that last game. You good?
Just needed ten quiet minutes. I am coming back out.
Cool. I am getting boba on 82nd after, and you are not going home with that face.
Fine, taro with less ice. Then I will tell you the short version.
Concert Friday: the group wants to pregame at Sam's roof, then rideshare.
I can meet at the venue instead. Roof hangs always turn into people passing things around.
Fair. We can grab tacos first and you can nurse one inside if you feel like it.
Perfect. Tacos, one max, then water. Also please pick seats away from the outdoor door.
There is thick paper from county on table. Is it trash or you need?
Please keep it. I marked the pages about rent support and the bus measure but still need the judge section.
I put it by your water bottle. Do not stay up too late after work.
Can you grab cereal and the blue detergent after work?
Yeah. Mom's list is already at 96 before your cereal lol.
I can skip the snacks if it's too much.
You're fine. I planned for groceries this pay period, just don't add energy drinks.
Dad's phone locked him out again. He keeps saying it wants a code from the email.
Tell him đừng thử nữa. Too many tries and it freezes. I'll reset it before dinner.
Also mom put that hospital envelope on your bed lol
Of course she did. Leave both there and don't throw away the tiny login paper.
Are you still using my laptop? I need it for school after 10.
Almost done. Comparing the April prices from the sheet with the fare alerts.
The one with the red bridge photos or the Tokyo stuff you keep saving?
Red bridge first. Tokyo is just parked in the other folder.
6:15 at Irving Park? I have three people already.
I'm in, but no hero moves if my left side feels weird. Last year's stupid landing still haunts me.
Fine, I will yell at you if you try to cut too hard. Pho after?
Pho after. I packed the wrap and those red tablets just in case.
After hoops Saturday, my aunties are asking who can fold banh tet leaves. You in or hiding?
I can help after 4. Ma will roast me if mine look crooked again.
Tell her yours are better than mine. Also can your dad bring the big cooler from his truck?
I'll ask. He usually gets back from deliveries around 3 if traffic isn't awful.
Pho after basketball or are you still being strict with app orders?
Pho is fine if we split. No delivery this week. I moved that money to the climb envelope.
You and those envelopes. Did you ever call the place about your teeth?
Only checked the estimate page. The jaw add-on made me close the tab.
Vertical World after your shift or are you wiped?
I can climb, just no post-climb food spot. My laptop file says I already used the fun column fixing the tire.
Bring a snack. Also did your Friday move happen?
Yep, the little sweep posted after the check hit. I matched it on the laptop before leaving.
That clip from the council hearing bothered me. The first question was about the guy's file, not whether he got home alive.
Yeah. The file can matter, but if the room starts there, nobody has to picture his mom waiting by the phone.
Do you still want to go Tuesday after climbing?
Yes. I want to hear the parts on clinic access and the families getting renewal paperwork bounced back.
That meeting got tense. You were careful with your words.
I don't want to trash everyone doing the job. I just hate when a rough takedown gets treated like paperwork with no timeline or outside eyes.
The part about translations after booking was solid too.
People shouldn't have to guess what they signed. Same with camera clips: useful if the search trail is visible and families aren't turned into background footage.
Still climbing tomorrow or did work drain you?
Still in. I just need my floor reset tonight so I can do the 20 min stretch thing and write the ugly parts down.
Do that. Send me routes after if your hands are not dead.
Deal. Timer is already set for the slow counts so I don't scroll until 1.
Rain stopped. Cousins still want 5s at Peninsula by 3.
I am in. If my legs are dead from yesterday's wall session, I am blaming Malia.
Fine, you can guard whoever complains least. Pho after?
Yes. I need cousins yelling about missed shots more than people asking about the facility.
Concert page says 21+ for the floor. We can still do balcony if you want.
Balcony is fine. I am not trying to get turned away at the door.
I forgot you are stuck with that until 9/14. Pho after instead?
You still coming for pho after pickup? I saved you a seat.
Pho after works. Put me down for the cheap seats.
Yes. Stayed late because J. asked how I talk someone down when the tier gets loud, and I made him run it twice instead of just handing him my notes.
That sounds like you. Make people do the work, but don't clown them.
Trying. Also trying not to act like every question is a trap. I can answer once and leave it there.
I found the old card in kitchen drawer. You need it today?
Yes please put it with my wallet. The nurse said they may update it if I do the March appointment.
Check the county page again. Times change.
I did. Their page matches the clinic text, so I am keeping the 11:20 slot.
I changed oil in the Honda. You need car Sunday morning?
Only for gym and maybe coffee with J after. Nobody riding with me.
Okay. Keep tank above half if work calls you in.
I will. Back before dinner unless coffee runs long.
Before you sleep, check if the insurance pulled already.
It did. 212 car insurance and 166 phones both cleared. I moved 900 from my check so rent money stays separate.
Keep the receipts together. Tax lady always asks where each deposit came from.
I labeled yours, Mom's, and mine. Nothing else came in this month except the small refund from the clinic.
Before I send the rent number, did the county paper show what came in this month?
First line was $1,452.38. The second should be about the same Friday.
Then keep the card payment small until it clears. No need to guess.
Yeah, I already set the bank alert. No extra envelopes coming in between.
After work can you look at my account? Co Chau sent pictures and I cannot find where people answered yes.
Yes. I will show you again where the event tab is.
Also call Ong Ba before too late. They ask if you remember the prayer table from last year.
I remember. I can set the fruit and incense before we leave.
Can you grab printer paper before you come back? I need it for school.
Yeah. Put the envelope from the office by my shoes too.
The one with Mom Dad you and me on it?
Yep. Don't open it, just leave it by the door so I remember.
Are you still coming Saturday morning or are you escaping after the food dropoff lol
After hoops, can you help me figure out that county page? My feed is all screenshots and insults.
Food dropoff, incense, bow with Mom, then probably leave. I work later.
Yeah. Bring it to pho. I saved the official link and one neighborhood paper link, not the comment-war stuff.
Fair. Auntie said bring the soup herbs too because Uncle's shoulder is acting up.
You never jump in, huh?
Nope. I just read, compare, and close it. Easier to talk in person.
I'll bring herbs and remind him about the follow-up sheet before everyone starts eating.
I saw your Sunday overnight pop up, so I nudged our thing to Wednesday.
Thank you. Wednesday works better if we keep it shorter.
Catan then, not the long one. Linh already clicked yes.
That works. I will bring the extra roads after dinner at home.
Internet bill came. 82. Due Tuesday.
I can take that one. My check cleared after shift.
Keep enough for car. Work is far.
I filled up yesterday, 58. Still okay.
Con, letter from work insurance. I put by rice cooker.
Okay Ba. I can look before my shift. Is it the one with the card picture?
Yes. It asks online only. Ma said maybe need appointment too.
I'll make the account and check the date. Để đó, don't mail anything yet.
If you go clinic, take the blue card. Do not pay first before they look.
I have it. Front desk said $25 today if I use the work plan card.
Good. After that you rest. Do not trade away all your earned hours.
I won't. The bid sheet rules are strict this month anyway, so I kept tomorrow open.
Can you sign the school form? It asks for birthplace and I put Portland for you on the sibling emergency thing.
Yeah that's right. Leave it on the counter by the altar shelf.
Ma said don't move the incense bowl. Also Dad needs the Costco receipt from his lunch run.
Receipt is in the blue folder with his pay stubs. I'll sign when I get home.
Pho after basketball or are you going home?
Let me ask what is cooked. If Mom has rice stuff ready I should not spend.
Fair. If you pass WinCo, their cilantro looked good yesterday.
I might grab cilantro and onions, then eat at home. I still have pork from Wednesday.
I saved us two evening passes for Tuesday. New blue route looks rude.
Perfect. I am off at 5:30, changing in the car, and pretending keys and radios do not exist.
Deal. We can do routes first, then tacos, and you get ten minutes max to vent.
Ten is generous. After that I only want chalk, sore hands, and salsa.
I saw the schedule you sent. Sunday morning climb instead of Friday night?
Sunday works. Friday I might just need food and no extra people.
Then we keep it small. Banh mi near my place, or tacos if you get out later?
Banh mi if before 10, tacos if not. Thank you for reading the room.
Home. I ate the pho you left. Linh's friends went to another place but I came back.
Good. You have work tomorrow. Did you drink enough water?
Yes. I had one with dinner and then soda water. Left when they moved outside.
Put your clothes near the washer if the outside smell followed you.
Can you grab me boba after your thing at Lloyd?
Maybe. It is just a quick walk and snack with A, then I am free.
Mom said don't forget Costco paper towels too.
I'll get both. No other stops after that.
After pickup today, pho or banh mi? Also did you finish that survey thing from work?
Banh mi. And yeah, I wrote that auto-highlights could help if they catch patterns, but only if names and faces are masked unless someone has a real reason.
You always add conditions lol.
Because conditions matter. I also picked the options for calm-down drills, interpreter phone access, and a clinician before things turn physical.
Rice and fish are in the fridge. Do not buy food after work.
I won't. I already marked groceries and gas low until next check because of the tire.
You paid that shop already?
Yes. I pulled from the other account, then fixed the numbers on my phone during break.
Can you grab milk after?
If I get out at 06:00, maybe. If they keep me till 08:00, remind me.
Mom said send something when you get back first.
I will. My boots are by the door and lunch is packed, so I'm leaving early.
Vertical World at 6:30 still good?
Yeah. I almost canceled because I kept looping on whether I sounded stupid in briefing, but I need chalk more than my notes app.
Bring the shoes. Also did Dr. P make you start anything daily?
No, just keep logging the loops and sleep. Body check was boring, so climbing is fine.
The city paper came. They ask about old court numbers for people in the house. I leave empty?
Yes, leave that part empty for you, mom, me, and little bro. I can scan it after my shift.
Also there is meeting about apartments on Powell and clinic forms. You want this flyer?
Please keep it. Those meetings keep connecting the same things: rent, getting seen at the clinic, and how people are treated when a uniform is in the room.
Keep your head clear today. New place takes time.
I will. I’m on doors and floor rounds first, then helping with the noon count if they keep me there.
Steady work is good. Learn it step by step. Benefits matter too.
That’s why I’m sticking with it. The training is a lot, but the raises are laid out if I pass each section.
Before buying extra things, look at house bills for April.
I did. Keeping the climbing charge, skipping the show this time, and I moved the tooth place to next payday.
Good. Keep what helps your body. Call them when you can.
Yeah. I still want that loud room where my brain shuts off, just not this check.
You home? Rice and fish in fridge. Don't buy food.
Home. Long night, but I kept the unit moving and helped N. fix her first incident write-up before I left.
Eat first. Sleep. Later you can tell me about the form for the next step.
I will. I didn't bring up the missing paper this time unless they asked. Just showed what I handled.
Before work, show me the address list you made. I want to know where you and the girls sleep in April.
I will. It is in the shared app with the food pins and the room total.
And the other pictures you saved, noodles and temples, those are not for this time?
No, those are later. This folder is only for the April one.
Can I use your desk for my history slides after dinner?
Yeah but keep the left side clear. I need the notebook there after my mat stuff.
The tiny one with all the bullet points?
Yep. And don't leave snack wrappers in here or I will make you sort the whole drawer.
Can you send the burger place from your story saves? My friend keeps asking.
Sent. I was already in there checking Malia's concert clip and a Tokyo food folder.
You're awake late again?
Just finishing the chapter where the neighbor changes his story. Then phone away.
After hoops tomorrow, can you look at that measure with me? My group chat is fighting about it.
Send me the page number from the pamphlet. I already saved KGW and the county explainer.
You really keep receipts for everything lol. Also did your arm stop bugging you from that clinic thing?
Yeah just one day. Bring boba money and I will show you the links after we play.
Vertical World has 4:40 open. You still want slab today after your game night yesterday?
Yes, but easy grades. I already did studio Monday and courts Thursday, so my legs are done.
Bring the sleeve. Those tiny footholds are rude.
Sleeve, chalk, and the store-brand 200s are in my bag. Cheap tacos after if I survive.
Lisbon hostel replied. Mixed dorm is okay, but the pub crawl wristband is strict.
Of course. I can skip that part and meet you after.
They said the cutoff changes for you after Sept 14, so this trip timing is just annoying.
Yeah, not worth forcing it. Save the food list and I will focus on that.
Still climbing Sunday, or did the PCC thing take over your whole brain?
Still climbing. I just keep replaying the advisor asking why I want the courts track.
You do not have to perform a perfect answer. Just be honest and specific.
I know. I just hate sounding like the girl who quit things. I want my application to look solid this time.
So are you bringing R to pho after pickup or is that already old news?
Lol old-ish. I might meet N for tacos Tuesday though.
You collect initials like punch cards. Anyway I saved two seats, you and me.
Perfect. I can stay late after my shift since I don't have to be anywhere early Sunday.
Do not buy food tonight. Soup and rice ready.
Okay. I checked March: rent and bills plus food, gas, clinic, school stuff is around 4,620 before tomorrow's water autopay.
Use the folder tomorrow. They ask many papers.
I put lease, ID copies, bank printout, and our pay stubs in it. No other letters in the drawer.
Vertical World next Wednesday? Trying not to pick the day your bank app decides your mood.
Wednesday is fine. The next county line is April 3, so I just need cheap dinner after.
Got it. Also did you ever start that resale thing you mentioned?
No, too much after shifts. My March budget is just the two bank lines and whatever I didn't spend.
